title: King Charles, Mountbatten and Savile's black berets

tellings.quote:
him and Lord Mountbatton

and uh Jimmy Savile used to all hang out
together

and they all had special black berets
made.

plain: King Charles, his great-uncle Lord Mountbatten, and the British television presenter Jimmy Savile are said to have spent time together in the 1970s and 1980s and to have had special black berets made for themselves. The comedian Kurt Metzger repeats this as something he was told, in a conversation about Jeffrey Epstein and a secret network of the powerful.
